market.what: ZDDP anti-wear additive in engine, gear and hydraulic oils, world
market.method: Bottom-up: 40 Mt lubes x ~45% engine oil x ~1% ZDDP = 180 kt + ~30 kt industrial = 210 kt x ~$3.5/kg (China list $2.3-3.1k/t) = $0.74B; reports say $2.4-3.4B (likely overstated)

value.logic: P-free AW stops catalyst poisoning: est. 5% PGM cut on ~$10B/yr gasoline autocat PGM = $0.5B; + copper-safe, low-conductivity AW for EV/hybrid e-fluids est. $0.1B
value.revenue_logic: Supply/license to additive majors: ~1.5% of 210 kt ZDDP-equivalent = 3 kt x ~$7/kg = ~$20M
value.margin_logic: Specialty additive (50-75); majors take package margin

trend.drivers: EV/hybrid e-fluids (reports 27-31%/yr) vs flat ZDDP (~4%/yr); P cap 0.08% in API SP/GF-6/GF-7; longer catalyst durability rules
trend.deadline: Euro 7 for new car types 29 Nov 2026 (longer emission durability)

competition.notes: 4 additive majors gate the market; ORNL ionic-liquid AW work licensed. Thin academic field, but buyers are an oligopoly

lab.synth: 1-2 step custom (amine phosphate, borate ester or thiadiazole), 3 variants
lab.test: Four-ball wear ASTM D4172, copper corrosion ASTM D130, SRV ASTM D6425, conductivity, RPVOT ASTM D2272 in PAO/Group III base; commercial lube lab
lab.logic: Synth 5-6 wk, $18k; blend + tests 3-4 wk, ~$10k (four-ball $99-199/sample) + formulation $2k

sale.gates: TSCA PMN/REACH; e-fluid/industrial bench + rig tests 1-2 yr for first order; engine-oil API/ILSAC engine tests ~$1-2M, 5+ yr, paid by partner
